updates.body: Axe Ready, the first limited edition for the soft launch, opens today at 1:00 PM. 100 total across four chains, 50 cents for registered members, a dollar for everyone else. Every piece is numbered Mint 1 of 100 to Mint 100 of 100.
updates.title: Minion 001 opens today at 1:00 PM

updates.body: Somebody swept the TV Heads floor today. The cheapest listing went from 0.99 XRP to 5.89 XRP, with 8 XRP traded in the last day. TV Heads is a 500 piece generative set, 137 owners.
updates.title: TV Heads swept
